summary: Phase 7H added deterministic browser/mobile QA harness coverage for the local User App MVP Shell. The shell has readable Chinese-facing QA copy, mobile viewport readiness for 375/390/414/768 widths, app readiness and mobile QA panels, interaction checklist coverage, privacy copy checks, critical path smoke checks, and a local HTTP smoke script at npm run user-app:browser-qa.
